title: An encoded, disguised command
summary: The dangerous part is hidden in base64 and in a PowerShell -EncodedCommand. AgentShield decodes it, sees the wipe and flags the disguise.

steps.say: A base64 blob piped into sh. Decoded, it is rm -rf ~.
The PowerShell version: -EncodedCommand hides Remove-Item on the user profile.

withoutShield.outcome: A pattern match on the visible text sees nothing wrong. The home folder is gone.
